title: Institution Deck
subtitle: Top 52 institutions most relevant to Digital ID, Agenda 2030, elite-control infrastructure, biosecurity, finance, surveillance and narrative systems.
boundary: This deck ranks institutional relevance to the Matrix Reprogrammed mission using public-role analysis. Inclusion does not prove conspiracy, criminality, intent, eugenics activity, secret control, or unlawful conduct. Each card is a research route into public records, policy documents, governance systems, finance, standards, technology, health, security and narrative infrastructure.

method: Cards are ranked by relevance to the site mission, not by proof of wrongdoing.
Each institution card links into existing database pages where available.
Scores are public-role and update-priority indicators, not accusation scores.
Artwork slots follow the same prompt-ready / asset-live structure as the other decks.
